description.plain:
Product description

Modern Standing Lamp - Beautify Your Room!

With the modern minimalist design concept, our industrial floor lamp mixed anti-rust finished black tubular metal body and stylish clear glass shade fits perfectly in any room from mid-century modern to traditional décor.

Note: Bulb Is NOT Included

 

  • Voltage: AC100-130V
  • Base Type: E26(Not Include Bulb)
  • Wattage: Max 60W
  • Switch Type: ON/OFF Switch On Cord
  • Wire Length: 1.8m/5.9ft
  • Height: 1.67m/5.5ft
  • Not Dimmable

 

 

A Classic Additon to Any Room

 

  • When light on - Clear glass shade allows the standing lamp to emit bright, clean, overhead lighting when you sit aside in working or reading.
  • When light off - With sturdy black stranding pole and clear glass shade, this modern floor lamp brings an eye-catching, timeless look to your room.

 

Elegant Clear Glass Shade

Comes with a sturdy clear glass lampshade that showcases the bulb your chose. Clear glass design allows your bulb to emit bright lighting to create a beautiful lighting atmosphere inside your house.

Sturdy Lamp Base & Convenient Foot Switch

· A foot pedal switch located at the cord of the floor lamp, very convenient to turn on/off the corner lamp with your foot.

· Designed with a weighted 9.84" metal base, which can firmly hold the standing light, provides good stability and durability that prevents tipping for daily use. Safe to have around children, aged, and pets.

Versatile Lamp

The corner lamp is compatible with a wide range of decor styles like new Nordic, mid-century, modern, classic, art deco. Adds a vintage yet upscale look to your living room, bedroom, study room, kids room, dorm, nursery, office.

It's Also A Perfect Gift

Industrial standing tall lamp could be a wonderful present for your family or friends.

The package has contained all components, just take a few minutes to screw all the parts of the lamp pole together.

Cautions

1.Cut off power before installing or cleaning the floor lamp.

2.Bulb does NOT include in the package.

3.The floor lamp supports up to 60 watts maximum.

description.plain:
Overview

This metal floor lamp has a balance arm in a black and gold finish that brings an industrial look to your living space. The lamp head, pole, and height can all be adjusted to direct light where you need it.

Features

  • Balance arm with a black and gold finish
  • Adjustable lighting: lamp head rotates 90°, lamp pole tilts 45°, and lamp height can be changed
  • Footswitch for convenient on/off control when your hands are full
  • 5.9 ft. power cable
  • Sturdy metal base that stays upright
  • Simple assembly required
  • E26 bulb base (bulb not included)

Dimensions

  • Overall Dimensions: 31.5" L x 11.75" W x 48.75" -65" H
  • Lampshade Size: Dia 10" x 5" H
  • Base Size: Dia 11.75" x 0.5" H
  • Cord Length: 5.9 ft
  • Bulb Power: 40 W
  • Input: 100-120 V, 60 Hz

Materials & Care

Constructed from metal in a black and gold color scheme.

Package includes: 1 x Floor Lamp, 1 x Manual.

media.alt_text: Industrial Metal Floor Lamp with Adjustable Arm

cta.description: Extensions: global catalog active — variants carry `seller.domain` (for `--business`), `url` (PDP), and `checkout_url` (buy-now) for cross-business routing; the seller identity lives at `variants[*].seller.domain`; run --input-schema to see the full accepted catalog payload, including `like`, context, filters, and extension fields. Cross-business results — each variant belongs to its own seller. Pick the seller AND variant the buyer wants (products[N].variants[M]) before proceeding. To create a cart, pass --business=<products[N].variants[M].seller.domain>. If chosen items span multiple seller.domain values, create one cart/checkout per seller. Buyer handoff: open products[N].variants[M].url for the PDP when the buyer is still browsing; open products[N].variants[M].checkout_url for buy-now handoff when the buyer wants business-hosted checkout. More results available (showing 8 of 557); paginate only if you need them.

commands.description: create a cart at the chosen business — substitute <seller-domain> from products[N].variants[M].seller.domain and <variant-id> from products[N].variants[M].id.

fetch next page — more of the same ranking: re-send your previous search body unchanged (query, filters, context, limit) with pagination.cursor set to result.pagination.cursor, copied verbatim; cursors are opaque and may invalidate across inventory changes; if results are weak or off-target, change query/context.intent instead and omit the cursor
